evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Speaker supplies a factual decision statement as given information, controlling the facts of the migration rather than arguing for it.
Evidence-based justification citing quantified performance and cost benefits to support the switch.
Note-taker records the decision as established fact in a structured heading, supplying the information without argument or appeal.
Quantified performance benefit recorded as evidence supporting the decision.
A fixed deadline is imposed on the migration, performing pressure via a binding time constraint.
